title: OPS-02 Dataset Split Specification and Leakage Firewall Architecture

partition_architecture.rule_of_partitioning: Splitting occurs strictly at the parent scene / acquisition cluster level BEFORE any spatial tiling, patch extraction, or preprocessing. Zero cross-partition tile assignment from the same parent is permitted.

TRAIN.purpose: Representation learning, gradient optimization, and feature representation discovery.

DEV.purpose: Model checkpoint selection, early stopping, hyperparameter diagnostic validation, and error analysis.
DEV.parent_independence_constraint: Must share zero parent scenes, zero related orbital passes, and zero spatial overlap with TRAIN.

HOLDOUT.purpose: Final, uncompromised benchmark evaluation of operational generalization.
firewall_rules: Zero access during exploratory data analysis (EDA).
Zero access for class weight calculation, anchor selection, or loss balancing.
Zero access for threshold tuning or post-processing calibration.
Zero access for model architecture selection or hyperparameter tuning.
Any evaluation on HOLDOUT requires a formal pre-registered evaluation protocol signed off in advance.

spatial_leakage_defense.parent_disjointness: No two tiles from the same parent scene or along-track pass may reside in different partitions.
spatial_leakage_defense.buffer_zone: For repeat-pass acquisitions covering adjacent waters, a minimum spatial buffer of 50 km between centroids is required for cross-partition assignment.
spatial_leakage_defense.stationary_feature_masking: Fixed infrastructure (rigs, wind farms, coastlines) must not be present in both TRAIN and evaluation splits without strict geographic partitioning.

temporal_leakage_defense.time_separation: Repeat acquisitions of the same geographic area must be separated by >= 30 days and verified for independent synoptic wind/wave conditions before being assigned across TRAIN and DEV.

derivation_leakage_defense.reprocessed_products: Different processing versions (e.g. IPF 2.x vs IPF 3.x) of the same physical acquisition must be identified by raw datatake ID and locked to the same partition.
derivation_leakage_defense.multi_annotation_merging: If multiple annotation sets exist for a single scene, they must be merged into a unified mask prior to partitioning, never split across partitions.

quarantine_and_audit.firewall_guardrail: Automated regression tests in CI must assert set_intersection(TRAIN_parents, DEV_parents) == empty and set_intersection(TRAIN_parents, HOLDOUT_parents) == empty and set_intersection(DEV_parents, HOLDOUT_parents) == empty.
quarantine_and_audit.failure_action: Any detected parent overlap immediately triggers dataset invalidation and quarantine.
